scope: Browser physical transport owner, original-operation status and finite journal/snapshot recovery. Local Node boundary fixtures use real EdDSA/ES256 WebCrypto signatures and simulated WSS/WT streams; no network, TLS, installed-browser outage or live movement qualification.
behavior: Expose preferred path, authenticated selected path, fallback cause and local physical epoch; selected path makes no media readiness claim.

At most two secure configured contacts, one enrollment capture and original bounded deadline per round. Only unsupported/missing preferred path or physical transport-stage failure permits fallback; authentication, trust, malformed configuration and authentication-stage timeout do not.
Explicit reconnect closes old physical/media owners, resolves fresh current enrollment and retains actor/Device IDs. No implicit reconnect, mutation buffering, resubmission or device replacement.
Pre-abort, resolver expiry/cancellation, concurrent reconnect and close prevent late physical adoption. Old recovery reads cannot populate a new epoch.

Original-ID recovery issues operation.get only and validates one exact scoped operation record, ledger kind, state and revision. Interrupted/unknown remain explicit; current authorization refusal propagates.

Finite Conversation catch-up excludes advisory hints; explicit resync reads current authorized snapshot. Exact signed 409/state/resync_required on a page restarts its read once within the original deadline; other errors are not retried.
Foreign journal summaries, foreign/unbounded snapshots and ambiguous multiple operation records retire the peer. Explicit development WT certificate hashes are copied before physical opening.
